Ceres Orbital Monitoring Station reports that at least one large mechanical unit, the 'Mandala,' has entered the Ceres sector.
Ceres has issued a red alert, and all civilian shipping has been suspended. Military reconnaissance indicates that the unit is currently active and shows no signs of retreating or changing course. If not destroyed in time, the Ceres colony and dozens of mining stations in the surrounding area will face a devastating blow. It must be destroyed before it enters Ceres orbit.
Locate and destroy the mechanical unit, the Mandala. There are a large number of escort mechanical units around it. These secondary units must be eliminated to create conditions for attacking the Mandala itself.
侦察系统探测到大规模机械体进入小行星带第五矿区外围。编队规模极其庞大，初步估算数:
The reconnaissance system has detected a large-scale mechanical force entering the outer periphery of the Asteroid Belt's Fifth Mining Zone. The formation size is extremely large, with an initial estimate of over five figures, and is still being reinforced.

The main defense fleet has established a defensive line in the main defense circle of the Fifth Mining Zone, preparing to confront the enemy head-on. However, the enemy's numbers are too large, and the situation is grim for a direct confrontation. If the enemy fully deploys, the defense circle of the Fifth Mining Zone will face the risk of being overwhelmed.

This operation cannot completely eliminate the invading enemy. The Allied Defense Command does not expect a single action to reverse the situation. The only realistic goal is to continuously inflict damage and weaken the enemy from the flanks, reducing the pressure on the main defense line and buying time and space for subsequent operations.
